$comment: THE DEFAULT. These are the constants a shipping auto-player uses in the actual game, which
makes them the only numbers on earth with any in-anger backing. They are still NOT measured:
no source documents a per-note cooldown, and if these are too fast the failure is SILENT
in game (dropped notes), not audible. Every value carries its source. See docs/CALIBRATION.md
for the six experiments that would turn 'measured': true on.

breathRest.$comment: Default ON. This is the one guard the reference tool added against an ACTUALLY OBSERVED in-game failure (判定粘连 on long continuous play), so defaulting it on is the fail-safe choice. Its 8s/90ms numbers are that author's guess.
